column1: # Written to develop the full-context coordination fix. NOT held out: these are
# for iteration. Expectations are the clause segmentation a careful reader would
# give, written before the baseline was measured.
# `probe --clauses`, because that is where the coordination decision is made.
# Downstream the shopping grouper splits products into their own rows, which
# would otherwise drown the signal this set exists to measure.
# Columns: id, utterance, expected clauses joined by " | ", family.
#   NP coordination  "buy milk and eggs"          one predicate, coordinated objects
#   VP coordination  "buy milk and text Daniel"   two predicates, shared subject
#   S  coordination  "buy milk and Sarah hates sushi"  right conjunct has its own subject
